name: ogxo-debug
description: Debug a running web app by driving the browser: reproduce the symptom, read console and network errors, fix, and verify in the page. Also css-alignment-debug, which injects temporary outline overlays and reads a screenshot of the rendered page for layout bugs that won't resolve from reading source. Also browser-testing: Playwright test scripts with dev-server detection; Playwright installs into the plugin's data directory during a one-time setup.
